note: Zoom on the chalkboard ledge (back wall, centre) of R_shapes_03. Five feminine nouns sit left of the divider (la file, la ride, la courbe, la diagonale, la déformation); the adjective circulaire sits at the right end. The chalkboard itself is blank; the pinned card is the sign.
